text:
maria.g: quick RFC follow-up — i sketched an artifact/event schema for quant precision regressions (fp8/int8/4bit) so console + oncall can triage. short sanity check pls.

samir: top Q — attach to profile only or model+profile+route?

maria.g: model+profile+route. need route to map to customer prompts.

li: use snake_case fields; add event_id, profile_version, severity_bucket {low,medium,high}.

aj: ops ask: compact json example + prometheus-friendly label set; also sampling_mode (hot/shadow/canary).

maria.g: example (redacted):
artifact_event: model=redwood-v2-medium; profile_id=fp8-aggressive-2026-12; profile_version=2; route=/chat/generate; event_id=evt-20261203-7; observed_at=2026-12-03T12:01:00Z; environment=prod; sampling_mode=hot; sampling_rate=0.001; severity_bucket=high; degrade_score=0.81; fidelity_budget=0.12; quality_anchor=qa_v2; anchor_examples=[short_weather]; token_index=15; residual_norm=0.039; kv_mismatch=false; sample_snippet="[redacted] less detail"; redaction_performed=true; metadata_ttl_seconds=1209600; sample_ttl_seconds=259200; explainability_collected=false; explainability_uri=""; collect_cost_ms=0.5; collect_size_bytes=20480; customer_tier=premium; canary_flag=false

jenna: metrics to emit: quant_artifact_count, quant_degrade_p50/p95, quant_anchor_regressions, quant_residual_norm_avg. labels: model,profile_id,route,severity_bucket,customer_tier,sampling_mode

samir: heavy Q — token-level explainability when degrade_score>0.85? gated opt-in for canaries; admin-only retrieval; audit every fetch.

maria.g: agreed. default explainability_collected=false. will add explainability_acl, redaction_version, and estimated cost numbers (~0.5ms p99, ~20kb). also adding artifact_resolution event with resolution_reason enum {rollout_rollback,profile_tweak,false_positive,noop} and resolver_name + notes.

aj: ops: sample_snippet must be scrubbed client-side; two-tier TTLs; hysteresis for auto-actions: sustain_window_seconds and min_event_count.

maria.g: will open PR with schema (snake_case), console mockups (diff + timeline), ingestion shim that emits compact labels, runbook (redaction, TTLs, hysteresis), and microbench numbers. tagging reviewers. :pray:

ops-bot: maria.g mentioned samir, li, aj, jenna in #eng-ml
